Factions? My faction is the violin.
The fire of Spain, for your orchestra.
In 1875 he gave the premiere of Lalo's Symphonie espagnole. He wrote Zigeunerweisen in 1878.
Symphonic poem Danse macabre (1874)
At the organ I yield to no one.
I will lend you French intelligence.
Organist of the Madeleine. Liszt called him 'the greatest organist in the world'.
Flute method (Taffanel–Gaubert)
The French flute is the best in the world.
The flute chair is mine.
Founder of the French flute school. He later conducted the Société des Concerts du Conservatoire.
Brahms: Clarinet Quintet
I come from the Meiningen court orchestra.
I will colour your orchestra with the song of the clarinet.
He rekindled the ageing Brahms's urge to compose and drew four clarinet masterpieces from him.
Flute Sonata 'Undine'
My duty is to guard the Gewandhaus tradition.
I will lend you the strength of tradition.
Gewandhaus Kapellmeister for 35 years from 1860.
Rosina in Il barbiere di Siviglia
My fee in advance — in gold.
My name on the poster larger than anyone's, please.
The highest-paid soprano of her day. She is said to have collected her fee before the curtain rose.
Double Bass Concerto No. 2
I will make the double bass sing.
Let me give you the song of the bass.
'The Paganini of the double bass'. In 1871 he conducted the premiere of Aida in Cairo.
Title role in Aida
If Maestro Verdi permits.
A song of triumph, in Aida's voice.
Soprano at the premiere of Verdi's Requiem (1874).
I am a farmer. I till the soil of Busseto.
The song of Italy, for your orchestra.

Contest before the Emperor

24 December 1781. Emperor Joseph II, to entertain the Russian Grand Duke and Duchess, has ordered a contest between you and Clementi.
In real life there was no winner. In a letter Mozart dismissed Clementi as 'a mere mechanicus'.
Accept
Defeated Clementi before the Emperor. Imperial gift of 500.
The Emperor was delighted and presented 50 ducats. The Clementi camp lost momentum.
Lost to Clementi in the contest before the Emperor.
Clementi's flawless technique won the Emperor's heart.
Premiere of Die Entführung aus dem Serail

First performed at the Burgtheater — a great success. The Emperor is said to have remarked, 'Too many notes.' Mozart's reply: 'Just as many as are needed, Your Majesty.'

Fame +30
/ You held the court: box-office takings +1,000
Married Constanze Weber. The wedding cost 300.
Haydn's words

Haydn told your father Leopold: 'Before God, your son is the greatest composer known to me.'

Haydn's rapport +40
Premiere of Le nozze di Figaro

First performed at the Burgtheater, to Da Ponte's libretto. So many arias were encored that the Emperor issued a ban on encores.

Fame +50
Figaro is the rage of Prague: 'Here they talk of nothing but Figaro.' Prague's level fell, making it easier to win over.
The 16-year-old Beethoven arrived in Vienna from Bonn (a turning point of the age).
Prague premiere of Don Giovanni
The overture is said to have been written in a single night, on the eve of the premiere.
You held Prague: box-office takings +1,500
Fame +40
26 February: Chopin makes his Paris debut at the Salle Pleyel.
Cholera in Paris
In the spring of 1832 cholera sweeps Paris. For two months, box-office takings in Paris are halved.
Young Liszt hears the Devil

In the audience at your concert sat the 20-year-old Franz Liszt. He vowed, it is said, to become 'the Paganini of the piano'.

Liszt's rapport +30
Hearing the Devil

You heard Paganini play in Paris. To achieve that transcendent virtuosity on the piano… you began to practise furiously.

Technique +2
Schumann founds the Neue Zeitschrift für Musik.
Premiere of Harold en Italie

The symphony with solo viola was first performed.

Fame +30
Premiere of Lucia di Lammermoor at the Teatro San Carlo in Naples.
Mendelssohn becomes Gewandhaus Kapellmeister. Leipzig's level rose.
In Dresden, crossing the ages, the young Wagner has appeared… (time crossing)
In Princess Belgiojoso's salon, Liszt and Thalberg met in contest. The verdict: 'Thalberg is the first pianist in the world — Liszt is the only one.'
Casino Paganini

There is a plan to open a 'Casino Paganini' in Paris, a concert hall and casino in one. The stake is 8,000 francs.
In real life the gambling licence was refused and the venture collapsed. If you hold the Opéra, you may be able to secure the licence.
Invest
History overturned!

With the Opéra behind you, the gambling licence was granted. The Casino Paganini is a roaring success.

+600 francs a month / Fame +40
As in real life, the Casino Paganini was refused its licence and closed. You lost 8,000 francs.
History repeats itself
The gambling licence was refused and the casino closed almost as soon as it opened. 8,000 francs gone.
Pass
A gift to Berlioz
Having heard Harold en Italie and the Symphonie fantastique, you feel moved to give the struggling Berlioz a large sum. In real life it was 20,000 francs.
Give 20,000 francs
You gave Berlioz 20,000 francs. Overwhelmed, he joined the orchestra.
Berlioz joins
'Only Berlioz can succeed Beethoven.' At your words, he wept.
Brahms has begun to grow his beard. From now on, the famous bearded face.
The first Bayreuth Festival

First complete performance of Der Ring des Nibelungen. Emperor Wilhelm I, Ludwig II, Tchaikovsky, Liszt and others listened.

But the deficit was enormous.
Fame +80 / Funds -3,000

The first complete performance of Wagner's Ring. The notables of all Europe gathered in Bayreuth.

The Wagner camp's level rose.
Premiere of Symphony No. 1

First performed in Karlsruhe. Some twenty years from first idea to completion. Bülow later called it 'Beethoven's Tenth'.

Fame +70
Brahms's First Symphony was first performed. The Brahms camp's level rose.
Symphony No. 2 first performed by the Vienna Philharmonic under Richter.
Premiere of the Violin Concerto

1 January, Leipzig Gewandhaus. Soloist: Joachim.

Fame +50
Brahms's Violin Concerto was first performed in Leipzig (soloist: Joachim).
Premiere of Parsifal

The sacred festival drama Parsifal was first performed in Bayreuth.

Fame +60
Premiere of Parsifal in Bayreuth.
